nodes.natural_language: If $\left(\sqrt[4]{11}\right)^{3x-3}=\frac{1}{5}$, what is the value of $\left(\sqrt[4]{11}\right)^{6x+2}$? Express your answer as a fraction. Show that it is \frac{121}{25}.
